title: Learning to Model and Ignore Dataset Bias with Mixed Capacity Ensembles

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image recognition models on an ImageNet-derived dataset (ImageNet Animals) that includes an out-of-domain test set with misleading backgrounds (e.g., a fish photographed on dry land) to penalize models relying on object-background correlations.

Testing visual question answering models on the VQA-CP v2 dataset, which uses different correlations between question types and answers in the training versus testing splits to penalize models relying on language priors rather than visual evidence.

Evaluating natural language inference models on the MNLI Hard and HANS adversarial datasets to penalize models that exploit superficial word associations (like the word 'not' implying contradiction) or premise-hypothesis word overlap.

Injecting superficial visual modifications (background colors, patches, splits) into the MNIST dataset to create a training correlation, and testing the models on out-of-domain sets where these artifact correlations are altered or removed.
